topic: Copeland's greatest-common-divisor conjecture for the Laguerre polynomial array in OEIS A131758
title: Exact contents in Copeland's polynomial-content conjecture via Carlitz's congruence

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For Copeland's polynomial-content conjecture (OEIS A131758, revision 48, COMMENTS block signed September 9, 2008), we determine every row content using Carlitz's polynomial congruence (1953/54, Theorem 3, equation (4.8)). The content is 1 at indices 0, 1 and all even indices, and 2 at every odd index at least 3. This replaces the proposed divisor-count formula; every index 6s+8, s>=0, also excludes its one-place shift. The proof identifies content with a fixed divisor of an integer Laguerre polynomial. Direct proofs of associated transform identities and normalization corrections are included.
summary: The complete row content is 1 for n=0, n=1 and even n, and 2 for odd n>=3. Both divisor-count indexings fail at all n=6s+8; exact equality cases and source-linked corollaries are proved.
